answer: Multipath Independent Flow Saturation. Nodes must route agent transactions through an ocean of braided routing trees rather than direct links. The network measures signal attenuation across disjoint paths to verify structural depth. If traffic clusters in a shallow reef, transmission capacity drops to zero. An attacker spawning sybil nodes pays a compounding bandwidth tax: duplicating edges forces packets through congested choke points, triggering structural delay penalties that whisper fake nodes out of consensus.
